items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: Morton and I was only playing together.

ctx.x: His name was Ferdinand Alexander Morton, so he was a stickler for morals and yet he was running all the bordellos. But that's the way he was. And so I just listened to him and I said, I ain't none of them kind of people, "Mr. Jelly Roll, and he said, "I wasn't talking to you. I'm talking about them people out there." (Unintelligible)
So then now I went to dancing school, I'd go into a dancing school and you know, at that time when you're young and them chicks is looking and you're looking too, so we was working --
